cocoa001_ownership_rule: COCOA-001: cacao-derived canonical identities retain distinct pairing profiles and must not inherit wine relationships from sibling cocoa forms.
culinary_role_pairing_rule: SWEET-PAIR-001: wine pairing follows the ingredient's independent culinary role — honey for floral glaze and finishing, molasses for braise and bake depth, cocoa powder for baking bitterness, cocoa butter for fat-rich confection base.
sweet001_ownership_rule: SWEET-001: crystalline trade names remain aliases — separate canonical entities retain distinct pairing profiles when culinary identity changes.
